content: No. The incident on 22 May 2025 was caused by auth‑service’s own pgx connection pool exhausting while auth‑db was responding slowly. Auth‑db had enough capacity (≈200 connections) for the 60 connections used by the two auth‑service pods, so it was not out of connection slots. The 503 errors were generated by auth‑service when its per‑pod login ceiling was reached.
